notes.title: Headlice at NZGDC 2025
notes.notes: [p]We’re back for our second year at the NZGDA Conference 2025, once again at Tākina Wellington Convention Centre![/p][p]Headlice will have its own booth, alongside a couple dozen other incredible NZ-made games. If you’re attending the conference, come by, say hi, and get hands-on with the latest demo.[/p][p]We had an amazing time last year meeting players, developers, and press—and we can’t wait to do it again. [/p]

notes.title: Minor patch 0.6.1 released
notes.notes:
[b]Patch notes[/b]

We released a minor patch today to the public demo. This addresses a couple of significant bugs, which were inadvertently brought in when we migrated to Unity 6. We also added more names and roles to the identity system. When you posess a human worker, check out their name tag when you turn them in to a meatsuit!

[list]
[*] The game-breaking bug where you cannot collect the Louse Gland has been resolved
[*] Turrets now fire bullets again instead of making an unholy loud sound
[*] Test of our "Kickstarter" names reward system with new names and roles added
[*] "New Game" and "Continue" removed in favour of "Play Demo" - this is translated in to all of our languages so it's clear this is a demo, not a full release!
[/list]

Is that a crab in your pocket or are you a victim of 90's corporate negligence? 🦀

notes.title: Headlice is on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Kickstarter is a crowdfunding platform that has produced some amazing products and game titles in the past.

The team at Bunguin Games will use the platform to boost our production budget to make sure [i]Headlice[/i] has the launch it deserves!

Join as a supporter to reserve your digital copy of the game, plus some backer-exclusive rewards - including in-game cosmetics, printed tees, and the chance to shape the game and see your ideas in the launched product.

notes.title: Minor patch 0.4.15 released
notes.notes:
[b]Patch notes[/b]

We released a minor patch today to the public demo. This addresses some minor bugs, and adds some new features based on player feedback. The major changes are around blunt force and ranged weapons, including some really fun options for combat.

[list]
[*] Fixes for missing kill zones out windows
[*] Minor crash fixes
[*] Possessing a guard will now give you full control over the guard's weapon
[*] Head pop is no longer automatic when possessing a guard
[*] When in a meatsuit, the player can use web grapple to pick up new weapons
[*] Full melee system added, including shove, blunt force, and stealth weapons
[/list]

Crabs in my cranium? It's more likely than you think 🦀

notes.title: Minor patch 0.4.12 released
notes.notes:
[b]Patch notes[/b]

We released a minor patch today to the public demo. This was to address minor bugs, as well as improved multilingual support.

[list]
[*] New menu system introduced
[*] Added support for Te Reo language
[*] Translations added for control schemes and other menu options
[*] Fix for missing "kill zones" between buildings
[*] Minor crash fixes
[*] Analytics TOS translated
[/list]

Happy crabbin! 🦀

notes.title: Spark Game Arena Live 2024
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to be one of the New Zealand indie game developers who will be showcasing our game at the Spark Game Arena Live on the 7th of September.

"[i]Watch tournament finalists compete live for over $140k in prizes. Complete side quests with free play games and the latest gaming technology. Explore talks from industry figures, NZ gaming studio showcases and more.[/i]"

Plus, come play our Headlice demo 🦀🦀 - and see the other amazing demos and teams that the awesome team at NZGDA have selected to spotlight!
